invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.089（基于ATR 0.0008调整），或融资费率Z-score回升至-50%以上（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊确认（价格跌破SMA50 0.10）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.089 (adjusted based on ATR 0.0008), or funding Z-score rises above -50% (short risk eases), or daily trend confirms bearish (price < SMA50 0.10).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格突破640（基于ATR 3.145调整），或融资费率Z-score回落至50%以下（多头风险缓解），或日线趋势转牛（价格突破SMA50 641.91）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks above 640 (adjusted based on ATR 3.145), or funding Z-score falls below 50% (long risk eases), or daily trend turns bullish (price > SMA50 641.91).
